purpose: Freeze one shared exploratory evidence/statistical surface for BREAKOUT_V1 and MEAN_REVERSION_V1 before any SFE performance observation.

evidence_classification.rule: No result from this surface may later be relabeled pristine confirmatory evidence.

dataset.instrument_identity: USTECH / Nasdaq 100 Index CFD as represented by SOURCE_B_USTECH_PRICE_CORE_V0_1
dataset.provider_chain: Public dataset CarlosSilva1/ustech-ticks; publisher documents Dukascopy via Tickstory
dataset.evaluation_surface: ALL 27677 ROWS OF THE EXACT CANONICAL H1 STREAM, subject only to preregistered signal warmup and t+1 admissibility.

data_construction.duplicate_source_timestamp_policy: SOURCE_B F1 qualified 0 equal-adjacent; any duplicate in governed rebuild is BLOCKED
data_construction.outlier_policy: NO OUTLIER CLIPPING OR WINSORIZATION; qualified finite positive bid/ask price-core values are retained as observed
data_construction.cleaning_policy: USE EXACT QUALIFIED SOURCE_B → AP0 → E1-03 PIPELINE; no new SFE-specific cleaning
data_construction.futures_roll_adjustment_policy: NOT_APPLICABLE: source is represented as USTECH/Nasdaq 100 Index CFD, not a futures contract
data_construction.daylight_saving_policy: NOT_APPLICABLE TO H1 BUCKETING: timestamps and H1 boundaries are UTC
continuity_rule: new block when current H1 start != previous H1 start + 3600000 ms

event_and_outcome.directional_event: EVERY eligible H1 bar whose adopted strategy signal is LONG or SHORT
event_and_outcome.response_required: Immediately following H1 row must be exactly +3600000 ms, same continuity_block_id, continuity_ordinal +1, finite positive close.
event_and_outcome.primary_estimand: Arithmetic mean of Y_t over ALL VALID DIRECTIONAL EVENTS for the family.
event_and_outcome.inadmissible_t1: Exclude from primary estimand and report diagnostics; never forward-fill.

inference_blocks.definition: Within each continuity block, eligible signal bars are partitioned into fixed non-overlapping 20-H1 inference blocks by floor((continuity_ordinal - 20)/20).
inference_blocks.reason: Pre-data dependence unit aligned with the frozen 20-H1 strategy horizon; no outcome-driven clustering.
inference_blocks.event_bearing_block: An inference block containing at least one valid directional event with admissible t+1.
inference_blocks.dependence_treatment: Arbitrary dependence is allowed within an inference block; blocks are the units for cluster jackknife inference.

primary_inference.estimator: theta = sum(Y_t) / N over all valid directional events
per_block_values: N_b = count(valid directional events in block b)
cluster_jackknife: K = number of event-bearing inference blocks
primary_inference.degeneracy_rule: If K<30, any denominator is zero, or SE is nonfinite or exactly zero, status = NOT_INTERPRETABLE / DEGENERATE_INFERENCE.
primary_inference.multiplicity: BONFERRONI ACROSS THE TWO DECISION-BEARING FAMILY EXPERIMENTS
primary_inference.note: This is an exploratory inferential rule on E1-exposed evidence; statistical significance does not create a profitability or confirmatory claim.

unconditional_drift.surface: all valid consecutive admissible H1 transitions in the canonical evaluation surface, regardless of SFE signal state

t1_exclusions: count and fraction of directional events excluded
median abs(C_t/C_(t-1)-1) for included vs excluded events where prior H1 is admissible

paired_execution_firewall.future_execution_if_authorized: ONE GOVERNED DUAL RUN: compute and persist both result envelopes before any human/model review of either result.
